sourceProject.name: Z80 tester
changes: Portable API and stereo transport
Copied MIDI parser: timed CC10 and SMPTE; source repository unchanged
SpessaSynth import rewritten to local pinned stb-vorbis.js
SpessaSynth CC123 releases keys through Note Off to respect the sustain pedal (MIDI 1.0 Appendix A-5)
Copied MIDI parser: no fixed per-channel or total note-count polyphony limit
Optional local voice DSP hooks: Hermite, filter, envelope gain, stereo/effect sends; scalar JS path retained
Structured scoped diagnostics for preset substitutions and unsupported MIDI/RPN/NRPN/GS/XG commands, independent of console logging; no DSP changes
Random pan RNG isolated per synthesizer for deterministic exact replay/seek; fixed 128-frame host quanta preserve partial-read state
Sequencer processes ordered trailing controllers and metadata instead of finishing at the last Note Off tick; PPQN tempo audio regressions cover acceleration, slowdown and seeking

Sequencer executes controller-only tracks and zero-duration setup files, applies timed port markers in event order, and initializes new-port channels with the same controller/preset defaults as port 0

SMF parser/writer preserve timed F0/F7 SysEx packets, escape bytes and End Of Track duration; bounded VLQs/chunks, correct running-status cancellation, extended headers and unknown chunks; per-port byte-stream decoder dispatches escaped channel/system messages and complete SysEx at final-byte time

MIDI 1.0/RP-018 Data Increment/Decrement with complete RPN/NRPN selection, per-parameter values and snapshots; RPN pitch sensitivity uses cents, MSBs clear old LSBs, live bend/modulation ranges update active voices, and RP-015 resets NRPN selectors and poly pressure without erasing parameter values
CC66 sostenuto captures per-voice key-down state only on pedal-on, preserves independent repeated notes, combines with CC64 and respects All Notes Off, reset and exact seeking

CC68 monophonic legato overlays channel mode, retunes existing sample layers without restarting DSP/envelopes, uses an independent portamento clock, and preserves per-key Note On/Off identities and sostenuto capture during fallback
Removed artificial 30 ms Note Off and 70 ms exclusive-class gate extensions; CC120 silences voices without consuming the sender's owed Note Off identities or changing pedals/controllers
CC69 Hold 2 freezes existing volume/modulation envelopes, preserves independent pedals and controllers, defers Note Off release until OFF and resumes ongoing release; native state stays synchronized

Note Off velocity preserved across SMF/F7, raw/scheduled MIDI, routed ports, per-key voice identities, pedals and events; Note On zero uses 64. Explicit preset response curves adjust release envelope times without reinterpreting SF2 sources or changing unconfigured banks. Forced drum release targets the owed Note On identity.

Host SoundFont part controls preserve ordered MIDI processing: receiver-port metadata, independent gain/pan and exact preset override, sample preparation, transport reconstruction and shared catalog/example UI; no upstream vendor changes.

Timed text metadata and shared lyrics/marker/display UI follow the real PPQN/SMPTE/port timeline; preserve original bytes, encoding and Channel Prefix semantics. Karaoke parsing no longer rewrites Lyric meta events into Text. GS/XG display packets are collected at final F7 and known LCD formats validate bounds/checksum.

Host rate/transpose and exact A/B transport preserve source-time coordinates and ordered commands. In-process synth/DSP checkpoints retain partial PCM, decoder, RNG and effect state without sample copies. Vendor RNG exposes state and sequencer accepts an inclusive loop boundary; default tick processing is unchanged.
Recognize native Yamaha XG SFX percussion bank MSB 126 alongside normal drum banks; unavailable SFX kits retain explicit drum fallback diagnostics.

GS effect DT1 extension validates checksums, ranges, all ordered payload bytes and partial EFX type writes; explicit unused/unknown parameter diagnostics. Added host overdrive/distortion models with Roland address/default maps, cabinet categories, mono routing, EQ, pan, level and sends; proprietary hardware transfer functions are not claimed.

voiceDSP.scope: Main sample/envelope/filter/mix loops, chorus, delay lines and Dattorro reverb; MIDI/SF2 parsing and extended insertion effects remain JavaScript

changes: Paths adapted to standalone Player; ordered real MIDI dispatch selects key/velocity regions, linked samples, timed ports and F7 messages
Verified samples load before playback with cancellation, bounded encoded LRU and independent per-song decoded banks
Merge the MIT FluidR3 GS supplement without replacing GM presets or recordings; explicit profile mappings preserve MIDI state and report real source patches, with generated CSV/JSON address tables.
